decision-inference.title: Decision Inference
decision-inference.description: Answering choice/score/noul typed questions against a state in a single bidirectional forward pass (CLI ask/answer/demo + RLAgent + wasm WasmAgent)

language-routing.title: Language Routing
language-routing.description: Deterministic script- + language-based routing that picks the English vs multilingual laya checkpoint for a state's text

checkpoint-management.title: Checkpoint Management
checkpoint-management.description: Checkpoint-directory resolution (explicit path, family root, cached download) and atomic Hugging Face downloads into the XDG cache

training-calibration.title: Training and Calibration
training-calibration.description: RLCD training (REINFORCE with Gaussian exploration, GRPO-style group baseline, TD(λ) episodes) over JSONL datasets, plus per-(question-type, option-count) temperature fitting

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.description: Release pipeline: platform archives (incl. CUDA flash-attn), crates.io, Homebrew, signed apt and pacman repositories

jev-server.title: JEV
jev-server.description: Jev/Simple-Jev protocol HTTP server: serve laya checkpoints behind the open Jev classifier contract (POST /v1/classifier, /v1/systemone alias, GET /health) with strict v1 request validation, laya-native answer mapping, single-flight model execution with admission queue, protocol error envelopes, and end-to-end conformance tests
